title: 📑 Bookmark Organizer: Personalized Navigation System🎯
summary: A custom bookmark organizer system that lets users create hierarchical folder structures to organize Business Central pages by workflow, with export and import capabilities via JSON. Complements native roles and bookmarks for personalized daily navigation, onboarding workflows, and process-specific page organization.
key_points: Users organize pages into hierarchical folders per role or process, not managed by IT, complementing native roles
Supports import/export of bookmark structures as JSON templates for sharing between users or backup
Includes a Role Center widget showing an expandable tree for quick page access alongside dedicated navigation pages
Enables scenarios like daily workflow shortcuts, structured new user onboarding paths, and month-end process routing

quotes.text: It's not meant to replace but rather complement both features.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the solution works alongside native roles and bookmarks rather than replacing them, reducing change resistance

quotes.text: The expandable tree allows you to navigate through folders and subfolders.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the core UI pattern that differentiates this from flat native bookmarks
